scope: Additive Home Village attacking Hero slot constraint. It does not select a Hero, configure equipment or affect defensive Banner behavior.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: Players have up to four Hero slots in their attacking army.

behavior_contract.implemented: Core rejects an initial army reserve containing more than four in-scope Hero entries. This deterministic scenario validation runs before adapters can submit commands.
non_derivations: The source does not establish a duplicate-Hero selection rule, so only the published total-slot limit is enforced.
Hero Equipment and pets remain excluded.

conclusion: The four-slot attacking Hero constraint is materialized without inferring any undisclosed selection or equipment rule.
